description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has launched the ₹1,725 crore Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Skill Training and Employment Sector Development Scheme, opening a portal and laying foundation stones for the first five centres. The scheme will offer AI, robotics, data science and language training through a hub-and-spoke network of nine zones covering all 75 districts, with AI-based dashboards for managing placements.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh has moved its largest skilling plan in recent years from the Cabinet table to the ground. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on 31 October 2026 launched the ₹1,725 crore Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Skill Training and Employment Sector Development Scheme at Lok Bhavan in Lucknow. The scheme aims to give young people in all 75 districts access to job-linked training, including courses in artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and data science. The launch was timed to the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Patel, observed as National Unity Day.
